## sarifix plan

Show the batches a fix run would attempt, and why findings are skipped

### Synopsis

Read SARIF, apply sarifix.yaml's rules, and print the batches a fix run would
attempt, in order, plus a count of skipped findings by reason. No agent is
called and nothing is written.

Batches group findings by <scanner>/<ruleId> (or campaign), split to respect
limits.files_per_batch and limits.findings_per_batch, ordered by severity
then size. Batches over limits.batches_per_run are listed as deferred.

```
sarifix plan [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  sarifix plan --sarif 'sarif/*.sarif'
  sarifix plan --sarif 'sarif/*.sarif' --rule 'checkov/*' --details
  sarifix plan --sarif pr.sarif --baseline base.sarif --json
```

### Options

```
      --baseline strings       SARIF of the base scan; findings also in it are skipped
      --baseline-root string   checkout the baseline was scanned in, for SARIF that 'sarifix scan' didn't write (default --repo)
      --campaign string        only findings in this campaign
      --details                list every finding under its batch, and every skipped finding that matches --rule and --campaign
  -h, --help                   help for plan
      --rule strings           only rule keys matching these globs, like trivy/DS-*
      --sarif strings          SARIF files or globs to read (required)
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --config string       path to sarifix.yaml (default "sarifix.yaml")
      --json                machine-readable JSON output

      --settings string     settings file (default: search XDG config and home)
```
